Description:
As a payroll compliance lead I want employer NIC parameters held by tax year so that a statutory change is a data update, not a code change.

Acceptance criteria:
Given the 2025-26 row is approved
When I view parameters for 6 April 2025
Then I see 15 percent, £417 monthly threshold and £10,500 allowance

Requirements: FR-01, NFR-01

Summary: US-02 Payment date selects the rules
Description:
As a payroll administrator I want the pay run to pick rules by payment date so that pay dated after 5 April uses the new rates automatically.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a pay run for March work
When the payment date is 10 April 2025
Then employer NIC uses 2025-26 parameters

Requirements: FR-02, NFR-02

As an employer I want employer NIC calculated at the correct rate and threshold so that my liability to HMRC is right.

Acceptance criteria:
Given gross pay of £2,500 paid on 28 April 2025
When the pay run completes
Then employer NIC is £312.45

Requirements: FR-03, FR-07

As an employer of apprentices I want the zero rate up to the upper secondary threshold kept so that I am not overcharged.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a category H employee earning £3,000
When the pay run completes
Then employer NIC is £0.00

Requirements: FR-04

As an eligible employer I want up to £10,500 offset against my employer NIC so that I receive the full allowance.

Acceptance criteria:
Given monthly employer NIC of £1,200
When month 9 is processed
Then allowance used to date is £10,500 and £300 is payable

Requirements: FR-05

As a larger employer I want to claim the allowance without the prior-year limit so that I am not wrongly blocked.

Acceptance criteria:
Given prior-year employer NIC of £180,000
When I open the claim screen for 2025-26
Then no limit warning is shown and I can claim

Requirements: FR-06

As a finance manager I want to compare employer NIC under old and new rules so that I can re-forecast my staff budget.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a completed March 2025 pay run
When I run the comparison report
Then each employee shows both amounts and the difference, with totals

Requirements: FR-08

As a client success manager I want each client told their estimated cost impact so that the April payroll does not surprise them.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a client with pay data for the last three months
When the notice is generated
Then it states the estimated annual change in employer NIC

Requirements: FR-09

Summary: US-09 Support view of rules used
Description:
As a support agent I want to see which tax-year rules a payslip used so that I can answer queries in one contact.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a payslip
When I open its calculation detail
Then the tax year and parameter values are shown

Requirements: FR-10
